description_en: Creates an agent account in the Cloud Customer Service System and returns the agent ID
description_zh: 创建悉犀客服工作台坐席账号，返回坐席ID
kebab_example: aliyun scsp create-agent --client-token 46c1341e-2648-447a-9b11-70b6a298d94d --instance-id ccc_xp_pre-cn-000 --account-name 123@123.com --display-name '刘测试' --skill-group-id 123456 --skill-group-id-list 123456145678 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAgent

parameters.help_en: The unique client request ID, used for idempotence checks. You can use a UUID to generate this value
parameters.help_zh: 客户请求唯一id，用于幂等校验，可以用uuid生成
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service instance. You can view this on the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID，在智能联络中心控制台上可以看到
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the agent account. The name must be unique within the instance. This value is used as the logon name
parameters.help_zh: 坐席账号名称，实例内唯一（登录名）
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en: The display name of the agent
parameters.name: display_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the skill group to which the agent belongs
parameters.name: skill_group_id

parameters.help_en: The list of skill group IDs to which the agent belongs
parameters.name: skill_group_id_list
